objectives: Multi-AI agent management: add, edit, delete, select, and configure multiple AI agents (name, image, provider, model, API key, temperature, max tokens, prompts)
Solid Pod connection: login/logout, show status, manage Solid OIDC credentials
CORS proxy configuration: select, add, and remove proxy URLs; set default proxy
Data extractor options: enable/disable extractors (Microdata, JSON-LD, RDFa, OpenGraph, Twitter Cards, Schema.org)
Bookmark management: export, import, and clear bookmarks
Data privacy: clear local storage and user data
Advanced options: toggle debug mode, show performance stats
About/version info: show app version, about dialog, and credits
Reset to defaults: revert all settings to default values
SPARQL Query Service: configure and test SPARQL endpoints (future)
LLM Chat: configure chat agent and chat settings (future)
Internationalization: change language and manage translations (optional)
Theme and appearance: light/dark mode, font size, UI preferences (optional)
Theme management: upload, select, validate, preview, and auto-discover themes (modular, user-extensible)
Accessibility: keyboard navigation, screen reader support (optional)
User profile: manage user info, avatar, and preferences (optional)
